interrupted.noTerminalResult: [Avibe Harness] This run ended without the Agent producing a result. The turn was released before the Agent replied, so no output was recorded. Check the Agent logs, then run it again if the work still needs doing.

interrupted.backendRefresh: [Avibe Harness] This run was interrupted because its Agent runtime was refreshed while the run was in flight, usually right after an Agent setting was saved. Nothing is wrong with the run itself — trigger it again.

interrupted.interrupted: [Avibe Harness] This run was interrupted while it was in flight. The interrupted attempt was recorded and was not requeued. Trigger it again if the work still needs doing.
interrupted.orphaned: [Avibe Harness] Nothing is executing this run, most likely because the service restarted during execution. Completed work is preserved. Trigger it again if the work still needs doing.
interrupted.transportUnavailable: [Avibe Harness] This run stayed queued because its chat platform never reconnected, so it was never delivered. Check the platform connection in Settings, then trigger it again.
interrupted.queueHoldExpired: [Avibe Harness] This run stayed queued behind its session's turn queue for too long and was never started. Check whether that session has a stuck turn, then trigger this run again.

action.staleInstallRuntime: Run `vibe doctor repair stale-install-runtime` to stop the stale service and start the current Avibe install.
action.restartFailed: Read the restart log named above for the cause, then run `vibe start`. If that reports a service already running, the failed generation is still occupying this instance: run `vibe doctor repair duplicate-service-processes`, which stops a process holding no lock and brings the service up, or `vibe stop` if the failed process holds the lock itself, and then repeat the start above.
action.staleRestartState: Run `vibe doctor repair stale-restart-state` to clear the stale restart marker and refresh status.
action.serviceLockUnverified: Run `vibe status` and inspect service logs before starting another service.
action.servicePidfileMismatch: Run `vibe restart` once the current work is idle so Avibe can rewrite runtime ownership files.
action.statusPidMismatch: Refresh status; if it remains stale, restart Avibe when safe.
action.duplicateServiceProcesses: Run `vibe doctor repair duplicate-service-processes` to stop extra service processes.
action.unverifiedServiceProcess: Inspect the process environment before starting another service.
action.deepScanSkipped: Run deep diagnostics to check duplicate service processes.
action.dependencyHttp404: Verify the exact URL from another network. If the release asset is absent, upgrade or reinstall Avibe; if it works elsewhere, fix the proxy or security gateway.

action.dependencyDnsFailed: Fix DNS access to the dependency host. {retry}
action.dependencyTlsFailed: Fix the host CA or HTTPS inspection proxy for the Avibe service, then retry the repair.
action.dependencyNetworkFailed: Allow HTTPS access to the dependency host. {retry}
action.dependencyStoreFailed: Fix the runtime cache permissions or available disk space, then retry the repair.
action.dependencyUnreachable: Inspect the Avibe log for the matching download exception, then retry the repair.
action.dependencyStatusFailed: Inspect the Avibe log and rerun Doctor.
action.nodeNotReady: Install a supported Node.js release (^20.19.0 or >=22.12.0).

action.dependencyProbeUnavailable: Inspect the dependency manifest and platform mapping before retrying.
action.showRuntimeStatusFailed: Inspect the Avibe log and reinstall the current Avibe release if package data is missing.
action.archiveCacheSkipped: Wait for the running install or clean to finish, then rerun Doctor.

action.explicitCommandMissing: Fix or remove VIBE_SHOW_RUNTIME_BIN, then rerun Doctor.
action.manifestMissing: Upgrade or reinstall Avibe from an official wheel that includes the pinned runtime manifest.
action.manifestPlatformUnsupported: Install Avibe on a supported platform or upgrade to a release that publishes this platform archive.

action.unpinnedArchiveProvider: Prefer the manifest-cache provider for official installations.

data.helpCommand: Inspect Avibe data, and run explicit trace-retention maintenance
data.helpDescription: Inspect local Avibe SQLite state with guarded read-only SQL, or run explicit maintenance: `query` is read-only, while `retention --run` deletes old internal trace events and may compact the database.

retention.invalidDays: --days must be between {minimum} and {maximum}; refusing to run instead of silently clamping the window.
retention.helpCommand: Show or run bounded retention for internal agent trace events
retention.helpDescription: Status and manual control for the agent_events trace retention policy: tool_call trace rows older than the retention window are deleted; messages, non-trace events, and newer traces are never touched.
retention.helpRun: Run one retention pass now (bypasses the daily cadence gate, still respects the lease).
retention.helpDays: Retention window override in days (default: the configured value, currently {current}).
retention.helpCompact: Also physically compact the database (VACUUM) when safe; implies --run. Off by default: VACUUM holds the database's sole writer lock and can stall the running service's writes; run it during a maintenance window or with the service stopped.
retention.configRecovered: The Avibe config could not be read (recovery defaults active); the retention policy is unknown. Re-run with an explicit --days window to delete anything.
retention.compactionReasonCheckpointBusy: the database is busy with concurrent readers/writers
retention.compactionReasonFreeSpace: there is not enough free disk space to rewrite the database safely
retention.compactionReasonOther: compaction was not safe to run
retention.plan: {count} trace row(s) older than {days} day(s) are eligible ({size} of payload text).
retention.neverRun: No retention run has completed yet.
retention.disabled: Trace retention is disabled in runtime config; the daily task will not delete anything.
retention.compaction: Reclaimable inside the database right now: {size}.
retention.compactionDeferred: Compaction deferred ({reason}); rows are deleted, disk space returns on a later safe pass.
retention.compactionSkipped: Compaction skipped: too little would be reclaimed.
retention.leaseLost: This pass lost its lease to another retention run; deletion stopped partway and no completion was recorded. Retry once the other run finishes.
retention.notDue: Retention already ran within the last day; nothing to do.
retention.busy: Another retention run is active; try again later.
retention.cancelled: Retention stopped at a batch boundary; no completion was recorded.
